**Finding: Compliant** — no redline proposed.

Section 11 ("Transition Assistance and Data Return") satisfies the preferred position on every material term:

- **Transition assistance (§11.1)** — up to six months on our request, at the rates in the expiring Order Form (slightly better for us than the playbook's "then-current rates"), and scoped to include knowledge transfer, export support, cooperation with a replacement supplier, migration, and continued service at existing scope and service levels.
- **Data return (§11.2)** — all Customer Data within thirty days in a complete, commonly used, documented, machine-readable format with metadata; expressly no withholding over a fee dispute.
- **Deletion and certification (§11.3)** — deletion only *after* we confirm successful return, written certification by an authorized officer, and any legally retained copy stays protected and use-restricted.

Cross-checks: §16.5 expressly defers to Sections 11 and 15 for Customer Data, so the general confidentiality return/destroy mechanic does not undercut these rights; §10.1 preserves our access through the agreed transition period. No walk-away features (no immediate deletion, no refusal to return data) are present.
